0.0.4.en: Added flow cards, removed settings, and fixed windows.

0.0.5.en: Fixed pairing errors, improved energy site icons, and filtered energy sites that dont have solar or battery.

0.0.7.en: Bump the Teslemetry SDK to fix a crash

0.1.0.en: Split energy sites into three devices, and added many more vehicle capabilities

0.1.2.en: Fixed energy history and some error handling bugs

0.1.4.en: Fix grid power and operation mode logic

0.1.5.en: Fixed the grid charging setting in both grid charge and export mode capabilities.

0.2.0.en: Fixed cumulative energy meters resetting at midnight, which was causing Homey's energy flow visualization to show incorrect grid usage. Added descriptive flow cards

0.2.1.en: Added remaining vehicle icons by Ivo Derksen

1.0.2.en: Fixed background errors that could appear after deleting a device, and added Cloud platform.

1.0.3.en: Reliability improvements: fixed re-authentication when your Teslemetry token expires, plus internal cleanups.

1.0.4.en: Added a Today's Solar Generation insight to the Solar device

1.0.5.en: Fixes the Powerwall device becoming unresponsive (no updates and no commands) after updating, and a crash when a Powerwall was removed while updating. Adds power/solar/grid/battery and tariff threshold Flow cards, buy/sell tariff cards, seat climate actions, and TPMS warning + Wall Connector fault alarms.

1.0.6.en: Fixes an app crash that could occur when a saved Flow still referenced a Powerwall that had been removed and re-paired. Improves resilience so devices no longer stop updating or stop responding to commands after an error during startup.

1.0.7.en: Fix Powerwall device that could stop updating and stop accepting commands after losing its energy-site link, now with a repair that preserves the device. Fix Solar generated today so it resets at local midnight.

1.0.8.en: New: vehicle at-home/at-work presence with arrival and departure triggers, and daily energy Insights (solar, grid import/export, home usage, battery charge/discharge). Improved energy-site device handling across app updates, and fixed several stability issues including tariff rate updates and device recovery.

1.0.9.en: Fixes Powerwall and Gateway devices not updating and flows not running (a packaging issue that prevented the tariff library from loading), plus a related crash.
